Your opportunity. At New Relic, you will learn and contribute to our massive-scale streaming data platform that powers our industry-leading observability ingestion pipelines.
What you'll do
- Build real-time data pipelines: Design and develop streaming pipelines that capture database changes from PostgreSQL and MySQL and deliver them to Apache Kafka using Apache Flink.
- Develop platform code: Write clean, well-tested Java for shared libraries, connectors, and developer tooling.
- Design data schemas (Protobuf).
- Operate production systems: Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot high-volume pipelines running on AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Take part in an on-call rotation.
- Write and improve unit and integration tests.
This role requires
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- 1 to 2 years of software engineering experience. Internships and substantial project work count.
- Strong programming fundamentals in Java, or another object-oriented language such as Kotlin, Scala, Go, or Python
- Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and problem solving
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Familiarity with Git, unit testing, and the Linux command line
Good to have skills
- Exposure to streaming or messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming
- Hands-on experience with AWS (S3 or IAM), Docker, or Kubernetes
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and observability
Bonus points if you have
- Academic projects, internships, or personal work involving backend services, data pipelines.
Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
